faq_section.title: AI Receptionist — questions and answers
faq_section.subtitle: Practical answers before we discuss your project.

questions.question: Is an AI receptionist the same as a voice agent?
questions.answer: A voice agent is a broader call-handling capability. An AI receptionist is a focused front-desk workflow and may use voice, website chat or both.

questions.question: Can it handle after-hours enquiries?
questions.answer: It can capture requests and give approved information outside staff hours when the selected channel is available. We define next-day follow-up and urgent escalation rules.

questions.question: Can I start with one location or channel?
questions.answer: Yes. A narrow first rollout lets your team test the FAQs, appointment rules and handoff workflow before expanding.

questions.question: Will it give professional advice to callers?
questions.answer: Its scope should be approved business information and intake tasks. Requests requiring professional judgment or a staff decision are directed to a person.
